discovery_timing: Detected by static implementation audit while the first workflow run was still in progress and before any result was accepted or canonicalized.
reason: The first V8 engine delegated paired ticket construction directly to the V7 cross-market helper. That helper requires every configured market to be sold before returning any ticket, while the V8 preregistration requires independent primary-WIDE and fallback-market eligibility with routing allowed when either route is available. The implementation therefore did not exactly encode the preregistered routing semantics.

corrective_action.implementation_change: Score WIDE and the configured fallback market independently through separate single-market helper calls, then select at most one ticket with WIDE priority and fallback only when no WIDE ticket qualifies.
